scene: The tapestry parts, revealing three curious transit portals out in the museum terrace.
picture: A flat side view along the open museum terrace. At the left of centre stands the girl in her windbreaker with sketchbook. Far left sits the paint-splattered tram on rails. In the centre hangs a striped rooftop gondola. At far right, the clockwork carousel train puffs brass steam beside a small turnstile.
shown: a colorful paint-splattered tram waiting with open doors on tracks at the far left
a striped rooftop gondola swaying gently from an overhead cable in the centre
a gleaming brass clockwork carousel train idling at a ticket gate on the far right
